g.text: Hook c13.3 | Loss and gradient through the fit
GU-002 · saved runs only · x = cumulative accepted steps; retries do not increment x
Segments break at stage changes. Loss catalogs and update directions can change there; jumps are not rejected steps.
D1–D4: damped stages. Real: undamped stage 4. M11 onward: full real catalog and increasing update band.
Top panels use different loss ranges. × = rejected loss trial. Gradient sizes are coordinate-dependent; compare within a stage.
